Itemized Passive Description:
*Activates the Entrance Animation when there is another
"Space-Traveling Warriors" or "Terrifying Conquerors"
Category ally on the team upon the character's entry*
- {passiveImg:once}Ki +6 and damage reduction rate 10%{passiveImg:up_g} for 1 turn
- {passiveImg:once}"Space-Traveling Warriors" or "Terrifying Conquerors"
Category allies' Ki +1 and ATK 20%{passiveImg:up_g}, plus an additional Ki +1
and ATK 30%{passiveImg:up_g} for characters who also belong to the
"Planetary Destruction" Category, for 4 turns
*Basic effect(s)*
- ATK & DEF 250%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Chance of performing a critical hit & damage reduction rate 50%{passiveImg:up_g}
*When HP is 50% or more*
- Guards all attacks
*When receiving an attack*
- DEF 300%{passiveImg:up_g}
*When attacking with 18 or more Ki*
- ATK 200%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Launches an additional Super Attack
*For every Super Attack performed with 18 or more Ki*
- {passiveImg:forever}Ki +3 (up to +6)
*When attacking with 24 Ki*
- ATK 200%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Chance of performing a critical hit 20%{passiveImg:up_g}
*For every Super Attack performed with 24 Ki*
- {passiveImg:forever}Ki +3 (up to +6)
*When the Domain "Tree of Might" is active*
- Receives an additional Ki +2 per Ki Sphere obtained
- Recovers 5% HP per Ki Sphere obtained (up to 50%)
- ATK 200%{passiveImg:up_g} and chance of performing a critical hit 30%{passiveImg:up_g}
when attacking
- Damage reduction rate 25%{passiveImg:up_g} when receiving an attack
